audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Urgot wins Levels 2 through First item, contradicting Kled's 56.15% win rate over 260 games, the packet levelChart (Skill/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill) and every why-string on the page, which describe Kled taking levels 2-6.
audit.why: Urgot has no dash out of Kled's E (Violent Tendencies re-dash) and his only escape/peel, Disdain (E), is a 16s-14s cooldown; Kled's E is 13s-9s, so Kled controls the early and mid lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 (Level 2 through First item) flipped to Kled in both layers; Level 1 and 2+ items stay Skill.

audit.why: Kled spikes at 2-3 with the full E-W-E pattern, again at 6 (R 140/125/110s) and on Eclipse; Urgot's real spike is two items, where percent-HP Purge damage and Fear Beyond Death (100/85/70s) outscale Kled's frontloaded burst.
audit.corrected: Spikes text left in place; only real cooldown numbers added where the prose already referenced the abilities.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named any of Urgot's abilities in the prose fields (Echoing Flames, Corrosive Charge, Purge, Disdain, Fear Beyond Death) and gave no cooldown numbers for the flip it tells you to track.
audit.why: Disdain (E) is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and shields Urgot on the charge; Purge (W) reaches only 490 units and slows Urgot himself while channelling, so stepping out of 490 turns his damage off entirely. Kled's Q (Beartrap) is a projectile that yanks and can be blocked by Wind Wall-class effects, and his E re-cast dodges the Disdain hitbox. Fear Beyond Death is an execute, so keeping Skaarl alive denies it a target.
audit.corrected: Real ability names and the 14-16s Disdain cooldown written into tldr, winCon, cooldown and interaction fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track it before every engage' with no number.
audit.why: Disdain is 14-16s at all ranks — the single longest gap in Urgot's kit and the whole window Kled needs.

edits.before: Dodge his flip — Q-pull onto him when his W is down. Kled wins by trading around Urgot's Disdain and cashing the pattern: q-pull onto him and out-aggro.
edits.after: Dodge Disdain (E) and Beartrap him the second it is spent. Kled wins inside that 14-16s gap: Q-yank, W's four attacks, then re-E back out before Purge ramps on him.

edits.before: Q-pull onto him and out-aggro. Track Disdain before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Beartrap (Q) him, yank in, dump W's four attacks. Commit only when Disdain (14-16s) is spent, and keep Skaarl alive.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it, then Q-pull. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Disdain (E), 14-16s: his only escape and his shield. Bait it, then Beartrap. - Purge (W) reaches 490 units and slows him while he channels — step outside it and his damage stops. - Your R (140/125/110s): kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. Dodge it, then Q-pull. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Disdain (E) is 14-16s and shields him: bait it, then Beartrap and W him. Purge (W) is 490 range and self-slows — walk out of it. Fear Beyond Death executes, so keep Skaarl alive.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it, then Q-pull. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain is 14-16s, his only dash. Bait it with a re-E, then Beartrap and commit.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge only reaches 490 units and slows him while it fires — step out and his damage stops.

notes: Level chart was inverted against the win rate, the packet chart and the page's own why-strings; fixed as a matched full/content pair.
